title: Ajaka (Olowo)
content:
Olowo Ajaka was a traditional ruler of Owo Kingdom, Ondo state, southwestern Nigeria. He succeeded his father, Olowo Ajagbusi Ekun. 


== Early life ==
Olowo Ajakawas born in Owo, Ondo State, and served as the traditional paramount ruler of Owo Kingdom. He succeeded his father Olowo Ajagbusi Ekun.
